name: wstack
description: A task workflow for Claude Code: confirm the spec, execute, verify with evidence, and deliver.

vault_path.title: Vault path
vault_path.description: Absolute path of the Obsidian vault.

tasks_dir.title: Tasks folder
tasks_dir.description: Task folder root, relative to the vault path.

retry_limit.title: Retry limit
retry_limit.description: Maximum fix-and-verify loops before the task waits for you.

r2_bucket.title: R2 bucket
r2_bucket.description: R2 bucket name for evidence. Leave empty for local-only evidence.

evidence_domain.title: Evidence domain
evidence_domain.description: Custom domain protected by Cloudflare Access, for example evidence.example.com.

evidence_retention_days.title: Evidence retention days
evidence_retention_days.description: Days before the R2 lifecycle rule deletes evidence.

local_evidence_only_repos.title: Local-only evidence repos
local_evidence_only_repos.description: Repository names (owner/repo) whose evidence never leaves this Mac.

pr_media_max_mb.title: PR media size limit (MB)
pr_media_max_mb.description: Size limit for each pull request attachment.
